title: Pipeline Options
description: Pipeline execution options: common settings plus per-runner (dataflow/direct/prism/portable/flink/spark) and per-cloud (gcp/aws) sections. Only the section for the runner in use is read.

tempLocation.description: Path for temporary files (gs://... on Dataflow)

project.description: GCP project the Dataflow job runs in

region.description: Regional endpoint of the Dataflow job (e.g. asia-northeast1)

tempLocation.description: Cloud Storage path for temporary files (gs://BUCKET/...)

stagingLocation.description: Cloud Storage path for staging local files (gs://BUCKET/...). Defaults to tempLocation

labels.description: User-defined job labels (additional-user-labels), visible in billing exports

autoscalingAlgorithm.description: Autoscaling mode: THROUGHPUT_BASED to enable, NONE to disable

flexRSGoal.description: Flexible Resource Scheduling goal for autoscaled batch jobs

numWorkers.description: Initial number of Compute Engine instances

maxNumWorkers.description: Maximum number of Compute Engine instances (1-1000)

numberOfWorkerHarnessThreads.description: Number of threads per worker harness process

workerMachineType.description: Compute Engine machine type for workers (e.g. n2-standard-2)

workerDiskType.description: Persistent Disk type, as a full disk type resource URL (e.g. compute.googleapis.com/projects/PROJECT/zones/ZONE/diskTypes/pd-ssd)

workerRegion.description: Compute Engine region for worker instances (when different from region)

workerZone.description: Compute Engine zone for worker instances

serviceAccount.description: Service account email the workers run as

impersonateServiceAccount.description: Service account (or delegation chain) to impersonate for API requests

network.description: Compute Engine network for worker instances

subnetwork.description: Compute Engine subnetwork: regions/REGION/subnetworks/SUBNETWORK or the fully qualified name

usePublicIps.description: Whether workers use external IP addresses (default true). Set false for internal IPs only

workerCacheMb.description: Size of the worker side-input cache in MB

createFromSnapshot.description: Snapshot ID to create the streaming job from

sdkContainerImage.description: Custom SDK container image for workers

sdkHarnessContainerImageOverrides.description: Overrides for SDK harness container images

streamingSideInputCacheExpirationMillis.description: Streaming side-input cache expiration in milliseconds

update.description: Update the running streaming job with the same jobName

transformNameMapping.description: Old-to-new transform name mapping used with update

dataflowServiceOptions.description: Additional Dataflow service options (job modes and configurations)

experiments.description: Experimental or pre-GA Dataflow features to enable

templateLocation.description: Cloud Storage path to write the classic template to

launcherMachineType.description: Machine type of the Flex Template launcher VM

targetParallelism.description: Target parallelism level (defaults to the number of available processors)

blockOnRun.description: Block until the pipeline completes (default true)

enforceImmutability.description: Check that PCollection elements are not mutated (default true)

enforceEncodability.description: Check that PCollection elements are encodable by their coders (default true)

idleShutdownTimeout.description: Shut Prism down after this idle period (e.g. 5m)

prismLocation.description: Path or URL of the Prism binary

prismVersionOverride.description: Prism version to download instead of the default

jobServerTimeout.description: Job server connection timeout in seconds

defaultEnvironmentType.description: SDK harness environment type (DOCKER, PROCESS, EXTERNAL, LOOPBACK)

enableHeapDumps.description: Enable heap dumps from the SDK harness

outputExecutablePath.description: Write the pipeline as an executable jar to this path instead of running it

sdkWorkerParallelism.description: Number of SDK workers per environment

flinkMaster.description: Address of the Flink JobManager. [local] for embedded, [auto] to detect from the environment (default)

parallelism.description: Degree of parallelism for distributing operations

maxParallelism.description: Pipeline-wide maximum parallelism (upper bound for scaling and number of key groups)

allowNonRestoredState.description: Skip savepoint state that cannot be restored (default false)

attachedMode.description: Submit in attached mode and wait for the job to finish (default true)

sparkMaster.description: Spark master URL: local[*], spark://host:port, yarn or k8s://https://host:port

storageLevel.description: Storage level for cached RDDs (default MEMORY_ONLY)

enableSparkMetricSinks.description: Report metrics to Spark metric sinks (default true)

preferGroupByKeyToHandleHugeValues.description: Prefer GroupByKey over Combine for huge values (default false)

bundleSize.description: Bundle size for read and write operations

batchIntervalMillis.description: Batch interval in milliseconds for the Spark streaming context

checkpointDurationMillis.description: Checkpoint duration in milliseconds for Spark streaming

maxRecordsPerBatch.description: Maximum records per batch for bounded reads

minReadTimeMillis.description: Minimum read time in milliseconds for micro-batch reads

readTimePercentage.description: Fraction (0-1) of the batch interval to use as read time

usesProvidedSparkContext.description: Use a provided Spark context instead of creating one

filesToStage.description: Local files to stage on all Spark workers

project.description: Google Cloud project ID (required for Dataflow; set this or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT when running off Google Cloud)

credentials.description: Where to load GCP credentials from instead of Application Default Credentials: inline JSON, classpath:..., gs:// or s3:// path, or a local file

impersonateServiceAccount.description: Service account (or comma-separated delegation chain) to impersonate for all API requests

workerRegion.description: Compute Engine region for launching worker instances

workerZone.description: Compute Engine zone for launching worker instances

dataflowKmsKey.description: Customer-managed encryption key (Cloud KMS) for data at rest; requires tempLocation

gcpOauthScopes.description: OAuth scopes requested when creating the default Google Cloud credentials

pubsubRootUrl.description: Root URL of the Pub/Sub API; point at host:port of a local emulator

bigqueryProject.description: BigQuery project ID to connect to

enableStorageReadApiV2.description: Enable Storage Read API v2 (default false)

useStorageApiConnectionPool.description: Use the Storage API connection pool

firestoreProject.description: Firestore project ID to connect to

firestoreHost.description: host:port of a Firestore instance to use instead of the live service

emulatorHost.description: host:port of a Firestore emulator to use instead of the live service

firestoreDb.description: Firestore database ID to connect to

endpoint.description: Service endpoint override, e.g. http://localhost:4566 for LocalStack

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: How AWS credentials are obtained. Omit to use the default provider chain (env vars, profile, EC2/ECS/EKS role)

type.description: Credential type. Inferred when omitted: assumeRole if roleArn is set, static if accessKey is set, otherwise default

accessKey.description: (static) Access key ID; prefer IAM roles or assumeRole

sessionToken.description: (static, optional) Session token for temporary credentials

roleArn.description: (assumeRole, gcpFederation) ARN of the IAM role to assume via STS

externalId.description: (assumeRole, optional) External ID required by the role's trust policy

durationSeconds.description: (assumeRole, gcpFederation, optional) Session duration in seconds

audience.description: (gcpFederation, optional) OIDC audience of the GCP ID token (defaults to roleArn)

plannerName.description: Query planner class, e.g. org.apache.beam.sdk.extensions.sql.impl.CalciteQueryPlanner or ZetaSQLQueryPlanner

zetaSqlDefaultTimezone.description: Default timezone for the ZetaSQL planner

verifyRowValues.description: Verify row values against the schema (default false)

expansionServiceConfigFile.title: Expansion Service Config File
expansionServiceConfigFile.description: Path to expansion service config file

useConfigDependenciesForManaged.title: Use Config Dependencies for Managed
useConfigDependenciesForManaged.description: Use config for managed transform dependencies

useTransformService.title: Use Transform Service
useTransformService.description: Use transform service for Python transforms

customBeamRequirement.title: Custom Beam Requirement
customBeamRequirement.description: Custom Apache Beam Python package requirement

alsoStartLoopbackWorker.title: Also Start Loopback Worker
alsoStartLoopbackWorker.description: Start loopback worker for Python expansion
